HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

4. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

7. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   D. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Nationalism in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

3. C — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. D — Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. B — Nairobi

7. D — Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Plan income and spending wisely

9. D — Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Modern Nationalism in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of American Revolution; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
